author: Claude
what_it_is: producer.py takes the ORIGINAL and PREPARED raw ADTs separately. It requires ORIGINAL to predate the pinned setup_adt product rewrite and PREPARED to carry exactly one. It proves, over the frozen inventory's properties, that PREPARED is ORIGINAL minus the pinned HV's USB0 subtree deletion and first-__OS_LOG removal and nothing else, then emits every ORIGINAL row into the unchanged facts v1 wire. Unchanged properties are byte-exact; rewritten ones equal the pinned m1n1 rebuild. Identity slot 3 stays the PREPARED tree. The guest gets the original rows plus opaque composite labels only.
host_boundary: source_selection.select(hv, proxy_module) accepts only hv.iodev that is the pinned IODEV.USB0 member (standard-metaclass IntEnum named IODEV, defined in the supplied module, with the exact pinned member table), converts with int.__int__ and returns built-in int 4. A plain int 4, bool, USB1 or other member, another enum with value 4, an int subclass and a missing/None witness refuse; a class's own __int__ is never called. producer requires type(source_iodev) is int and == 4.

caps.behaviour: refuse on overflow; no truncation, clipping, merging or dropping of below-RAM rows
